ContentDescription: A stylised black Yamaha C5 grand piano (a medium-size concert grand, about 2 metres long), lid raised on the long prop, seen from a low three-quarter angle, placed in the LEFT HALF of the frame on a dark, quiet stage. A single warm spotlight falls on the keyboard and the brass of the pedals. Elegant and restrained, like a 1980s record sleeve for a classical album. The RIGHT 40 percent of the frame is a plain, smooth, very dark blue-black wall with no objects, so a list of titles can be written there later. The bottom quarter is an almost empty dark polished floor with no objects, so oscilloscope traces can be drawn there.

Layout.TextSafeZone: right 40 percent and bottom quarter must be dark, smooth and empty
Layout.NegativeSpace: right 40 percent and bottom quarter empty and dark

Style.Genre: Classic 16-bit home computer title screen art, Amiga era, refined and stylised
Style.Rendering: Flat stylised shapes with bold, clean edges and a few large gradients; simple enough to survive reduction to 320x200 pixels in 16 colours; no fine textures, no noise, no grain, no small details, no lettering

Lighting.Type: Single dramatic warm spotlight from above
Sources: Faint cool rim light along the piano's curve

ColorPalette.Treatment: Very limited palette of about 12 colours, mostly dark blues and blacks, with ivory and gold highlights only where the light falls

Effects: Soft pool of light on the floor under the keyboard
Faint reflection of the piano on the dark floor

Situation.Name: The nocturne
Situation.Setting: An empty dark stage, no audience visible, no walls in detail
Situation.Camera: Low three-quarter view from the front left of the keyboard; the whole piano fits inside the left half of the frame

Conceptual.Name: Grand piano
Conceptual.Description: Black lacquer Yamaha C5 grand piano, lid on the long prop, music desk empty, keys visible
Conceptual.Application: Left half, not crossing the centre line
Conceptual.SymbolicMeaning: The instrument itself, as the subject

CompositionNotes: The final image will be cropped to its central 4:3 area and reduced to 320x200 pixels with 16 colours, so keep shapes large and clear and the palette small. Inside that central 4:3 area: the piano in the left half, an empty dark wall in the right 40 percent, an empty dark floor in the bottom quarter. No text, logos or signatures anywhere.
